pages.text: There are three ways in, and the furnace sorts what it gets: coke dust goes to the fuel, limesand to the flux slot, ore to the ore slot.

$(li)$(item)Drop items into the shaft$() from the top. They are collected where they land, in the space just above the bottom centre.$(li)$(item)Insert into the output block$() with a funnel, a hopper or a chute, from any side.$(li)$(item)Insert into the top gas hatch$(): items fall down the shaft.

$(l)Limits$()$(li)$(item)Ore$(): one kind at a time, up to 64. Only ore that a furnace recipe can smelt is taken; anything else stays where it is, so a stray item can no longer jam the furnace.$(li)$(item)Flux$(): up to 64 limesand.$(li)$(item)Fuel$(): up to 64 coke dust. The furnace burns $(item)one dust every 600 ticks$() (30 s) of work.
Nothing can be pulled back out of the output block: it only gives fluids.$(br2)Do not stand in the shaft. A working furnace burns anything inside it.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
